studio_intro: Brand voice, caption and idea generation, comment replies and experiments. Nothing is sent until you press a button.
studio_off_hint: The Studio uses your own API key (or Ollama running on this computer). Turn it on in Settings → AI assistant.
studio_coming_soon: This section is not available yet.
studio_local_badge: Local · data stays on this computer
studio_budget_over: Estimated spend this month ({s}) is over your monthly budget ({b}).
usage_intro: Token counts are as reported by the provider; costs are estimated from list prices and may differ from your invoice.
usage_empty: No AI calls in this period.
usage_unknown_note: {n} calls have unknown pricing (not included in the total). You can enter prices in Settings → AI.
ai_show_cost: Show tokens and estimated cost on results
ai_budget_hint: Shows a warning when exceeded; requests are not blocked. Empty = no budget.
ai_keep_history_hint: When off, only counts (tokens, image count) are stored, never content.
ai_vision: Send images to the model (vision-capable models)
ai_vision_hint: Images are downscaled to at most 1568 px before sending. Videos are never sent, only the cover frame.
ai_prices_hint: Anthropic list prices; other providers are estimates and change often. Correct them by entering your own price.
